svg.title: Kangchenjunga — mountain relief
svg.desc: Southwest Yalung face. Yalung Kang, the main summit, the Great Shelf and glaciated southwest wall. Layered vector contour adaptation of a photograph by Carsten.nebel. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Kangchenjunga_South_Face.jpg. License: CC BY-SA 3.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0. Changes: sky removed, cropped, tonal contours traced, blue and white palette.
